_comment: Durable in-repo provenance sidecar for pipeline-hero trace lines whose verbatim source is absent from a clean clone: text that lived only in gitignored working docs (docs/dev/*), and text harvested from a commit that exists only in the private repository's history. Under D30 the public repository receives the clean tree as one commit per publish, so a commit-id source_ref cannot resolve in a public clone and the strict audit would fail there; those lines (s12/s13/s15) cite this file instead. Each entry records the verbatim rendered text, where it was harvested from (the original gitignored origin path, or for a commit-sourced line the commit's subject line, its short id, or the push output naming it), and the commit that harvest belongs to. Referenced by .github/assets/demo-trace.json via source_ref=this file and source_locator=<key>. Condensation lines (s04/s07/s09) are stylized single-line condensations derived from their origin doc, not verbatim substrings of it.

s02.text: Document how the README hero demo is captured and why it is authentic

s03.text: every visible line traces to a real /spec→/dev→/close→/commit→/push run artifact

s06.text: Built a deterministic paper-substrate animated-SVG demo system for the README hero

s12.text: feat(demo): deterministic paper-substrate hero-SVG generator + trace audit
